headline: The neighbours spat — and the cat broke it up
lede: Homebody's last bond-line gap is closed: Miso and Pip now mediate Fern and Ivy. Park a mediator between a quarrelling pair and the cold war cracks on the spot — soft warmth lands, the reunion pays faster, and the offence itself still stands. Once per spat, deterministic, seed-exact.

notes.text: HOMEBODY: Miso or Pip within three tiles of both quarrellers ends the Fern-Ivy cold war (NEIGH_MEDIATE_PAY + the mending lane); cat asked before kid, sleepers inert, once-per-spat ledger rides the save hash.

peoplecheck 850/850 with a new mediation section; the hand-mutant (deleting the spat-time reset) reddened exactly the two pins that own that line. Standalone browser proof fired the law in ~100 ms with the leaf sparkle on the real canvas.

End-of-suite drive legs can ride state the night legs leave behind — the mediation leg saw every cell perfect but the world clock frozen (hour 8.0 through seconds of polling); deferred to QA as #2674 with the diagnostics wired into the drive's own fail output.
